title: When is Kaizer Chiefs' next match against TS Galaxy?
text:
When is Kaizer Chiefs’ next match against TS Galaxy?
All you need to know.
Kaizer Chiefs have finally lost their unbeaten record in the Betway Premiership. It’s not going down well with supporters.
Now, they’ll go into their next league assignment under a cloud of uncertainty.
Coach Nasreddine Nabi has reportedly been sacked.
Kaizer Chiefs injury news: Rushwin Dortley
Who will coach Chiefs against TS Galaxy?
After a superb start to the season, it’s back to the drawing board for Nabi and his charges after their 3-1 home defeat to an impressive Sekhukhune side. Babina Noko and Sundowns are now the only remaining unbeaten sides in the division. Chiefs, meanwhile, face TS Galaxy away on Sunday, 21 September at 15:00.
Nabi hints at Kaizer Chiefs exits
“It’s true that the squad is big and the technical staff, management, the sporting director, Kaizer Junior, is working on options to try offload the squad, to give some players, who didn’t have consistency or time to get more game-time, to other teams,” coach Nasreddine Nabi said.
Who will oversee those exits, however? News filtered through on Wednesday that Chiefs and Nabi have parted ways after the club revealed that the Tunisian tactician doesn’t hold the correct coaching qualifications to sit in the dugout for the upcoming CAF Confederation Cup campaign.
